verdict.rationale: Babylon.js docs claim "TypeScript support with full IntelliSense" and publish TypeDoc-generated API references through its official NPM packages. A community user independently confirms the TypeScript integration works well, so a coding agent's editor can attach to typed definitions for completions. missing for 10: explicit documentation of the shipped .d.ts declaration files and how editors consume them, evidence covering diagnostics and go-to-definition navigation specifically, in-depth first-party tooling docs beyond a one-line llms.txt claim.
